items.quote: Wir stellen Ihren Anschluss am 08.04.2025 bereit; der Techniker meldet sich vorher bei Ihnen.
items.computation: The letter states the provision (Bereitstellung) date explicitly as 08.04.2025; the technician will contact the customer beforehand to arrange the exact appointment time.

warnings: Contract-term calculation: the minimum term is '12 Monate ab Bereitstellung' (provision 08.04.2025); under §§187(1), 188(2) BGB the day of provision is not counted and the term ends with expiry of the calendar anniversary, i.e. 08.04.2026, so the current_term_end shown is 2026-04-08.

The one-month notice deadline to cancel at expiry of the minimum term would fall on 08.03.2026, which is a Sunday; per §193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 09.03.2026 — this is reflected in cancel_by.

The letter does not mention a statutory right of withdrawal (Widerrufsrecht), which normally applies for distance/online orders in Germany; check the order confirmation email or customer account for a separate Widerrufsbelehrung and its 14-day deadline.
The AGB and Leistungsbeschreibung referenced as part of the contract are not attached but only available in the online customer account — worth downloading and keeping a copy.
